text:
maria_sales: Quick sync — Evergreen Retail is asking for a short POC to validate tail latency and throughput for a mixed read + embedding workload. They expect ~1,200 concurrent shoppers, baseline 800 qps, peaks to 2k qps. Can we run a 2-hour smoke+stress next Tue 09:00 PST? They also want a rough hosted vs dedicated cost delta and a short blurb for their security team about KMS/HSM + retention.

sam_se: Ack. Sounds doable. My proposed run plan: warmup 20m, sustained sweep 60m (800→2000 qps in steps), 30m blast at 2k qps, 10m cooldown. Collect p50/p95/p99, tail (99.9) latency, GPU utilization, and cache hit rates. Model: redwood/retail-13b-quant (4-bit) + prefix KV cache enabled.

maria_sales: Perfect. Tom from Evergreen confirmed Tue works in morning PST.

devon_sre: I can own infra and metrics. Two notes: 1) enable continuous batching with max_batch_size=64 for generation path, 2) pin KV cache TTL to 600s to avoid cold-start noise. We'll export traces to the test Prometheus stack.

sam_se: Also recommend separate routes for embeddings vs text gen to avoid head-of-line blocking. We'll route embed calls to smaller model variant (retail-embed-2k) to save tokens.

maria_sales: Tom — pls confirm dataset will be sanitized and we can use synthetic payloads for the POC.

tom_evergreen: Confirmed. We'll provide sanitized sample queries and a small set of real-world shopping prompts. No PII.

devon_sre: Load generator snippet (k6) for smoke:

```
k6 run --vus 800 --duration 20m smoke.js --env TARGET_URL=https://api.redwood.test/generate --rps 1200
```

devon_sre: For the 2k blast we’ll scale up to 1200 VUs with ramping and use the k6 ramping executor. I’ll attach the exact script after cleaning.

raj_product: Quick perf knobs: 1)enable kv prefetch for top-10 prefixes, 2)set min_cache_ratio=0.6 so we don't thrash, 3)quant 4-bit gave best cost/latency in our last retail run.

anna_security: For the security blurb: Private (VPC) deployment supports customer-managed KMS (Cloud KMS/HSM). Hosted offers envelope encryption and we can sign an encryption appendix. Retention can be configured per route — common choices: 30/90/365 days. Also, we'll fill their security questionnaire by EOD Monday. Link to questionnaire: https://docs.redwood/security/questionnaires/evergreen.

maria_sales: Cost high-level for planning: hosted incremental for this test ~ $0.45-$0.75/hr per 1000 qps served (depends on tokens and model size). Dedicated reserved pool for expected steady-state (2k sustained) estimate ~ $5,000-$6,500/month depending on commit and region. Will put a short spreadsheet in the thread.

tom_evergreen: Can you give a delta for tail-latency SLA? They need 99th < 250ms for simple prompts and 99.9 < 800ms for generation-heavy flows.

sam_se: With our config + caching, realistic expectation: p99 ~ 120-220ms for short prompts, p99.9 ~ 500-700ms under 2k blast if KV cache hit >70% and batch_size<=64. If cache miss spike, p99.9 may hit ~1.2s. We'll capture both warm and cold cases.

anna_security: Also note: for FIPS/HSM requirements we need dedicated/private; hosted can't present physical HSM attestation per customer right now.

devon_sre: Action items: I'll provision a temporary dedicated test pool in us-west-2 (12 GPUs) for the blast window and wire up Prometheus + traces. sam_se to provide exact model config and test script. anna to drop security questionnaire link and PCA. maria to confirm schedule with Evergreen.

maria_sales: Thanks — I'll confirm and send calendar invite. Tom, any other must-haves from Evergreen?

tom_evergreen: One ask — can you include cost sensitivity: "if we move embeddings off the main route we save ~25% on token cost" — they want to see that tradeoff in the run notes.

sam_se: Yep — we'll run two variants during the sweep: combined route vs split routes and report token counts and cost per 1M requests.

deploy-bot: Load test slot reserved: Tue 2026-04-07 09:00 PST -> us-west-2 (temp-pool-evg). Owner: devon_sre.

maria_sales: Great. Final deliverables after run: 1) short results writeup (p50/p95/p99/p99.9, cost delta, cache hit rates), 2) ops runbook for Evergreen to hit their SLA, 3) security questionnaire response. Expect initial results within 24h after test. :thumbsup:
